name: Spire Global

overview.value: Spire Global is a space-to-cloud data and analytics company headquartered in San Francisco, California, founded in 2012. It specializes in tracking global data sets, such as maritime, aviation, and weather patterns, powered by a large constellation of over 110 nanosatellites it designs, builds, and operates. Spire began trading on the NYSE in August 2021 under the ticker SPIR following a SPAC merger. In November 2024, Spire sold its ship-tracking (AIS) business to Kpler of Belgium for $241 million.

focus.value: Space-to-cloud data and analytics from a nanosatellite constellation tracking maritime, aviation, and weather
